items.label: Arkansas income tax
items.note: Above $94,700 of net income a separate high-income table applies to all income, less a bracket adjustment that runs out by $97,600. The $29 personal credit ($58 married) is taken off.

notModelled: Arkansas's low-income tax tables, which lower tax below about $17,500 of income ($29,000 married)
Rounding to the Regular Income Tax Table's $100 rows (a dollar or two either way)
provisional: Standard deduction of $2,470 ($4,940 married) is the 2025 amount; the 2026 inflation-adjusted figure was not yet published
